svg.title: NNLCI: two 3 by 3 patches, one POI, a field assembled point by point
svg.desc: Schematic. LF1 and LF2 each contribute nine aligned sample locations with four variables. LF2 has a finer underlying mesh, not more input points. The 72 features enter an MLP, which predicts four variables only at the center POI. One output is placed in one grid cell; repeat at every target location to reconstruct the field. Puzzle colors are illustrative, not model results. HF labels reach only the training loss.
svg.text: 3 × 3 in. One point out. Assemble the field.
LF2 has a finer source mesh; both LF inputs still contain exactly nine locations.
Place at its coordinate; repeat for every target point
LF patches → MLP → one POI → field
